sequence: Cases run in order against one registry (chainId 11155111, verifyingContract 0x8350835083508350835083508350835083508350); each sees the state the accepted cases before it left. Space salt = keccak256("erc8350-client test space"); controller and authorizer keys as above. Delta n: deltaCommitment = keccak256("delta n"), profileId = keccak256("erc8350-client test profile"), provenance and locator zero. Rotation 1 moves the Space to controller-2 with the outsider key as authorizer; rotation 2 repeats that by direct call.
fields: call holds the operation's arguments. signingDigest is the digest the registry checks once the call reaches signature validation; cases refused by a state rule (ZeroAddress, SpaceAlreadyRegistered) never reach it. signedDigest, when present, is what was actually signed. signer is the key that signed, null for an empty or synthetic signature. refusedBy is the rule that must refuse the case: length, noncanonical, signer, or a state rule name.
